Question 2

The vector v=⟨2,−1⟩ is rotated π3 radians counterclockwise about the origin. Find the image of v under this rotation.

a
⟨−32,12⟩
b
⟨12−3,32−1⟩
c
⟨1+32,3−12⟩
d
⟨1+32,3−12⟩
e
⟨12,32⟩
